title: Paper accounts, integrity and budget boundaries
summary: Dev1-4 paper decisions generate balancing accounting entries and source-referenced receipts; local file locks and replay rules guard duplicate paper buys. These are simulation accounts, not a legal-entity general ledger or bank/provider transactions.
invariants: Every paper receipt has exactly one balanced commitment pair.
Missing posting recovery and duplicate/tamper rejection are separate actions.
A single-filesystem flock is not distributed leader fencing.
Never credit realized savings to accounts from a forecast or a migration status snapshot.
Accountant-grade monetary precision, exact byte counts, credits/taxes/FX and external invoice evidence are future authority responsibilities.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Audit ledger before admitting new paper commitments.
Reject altered/duplicate/orphan postings; repair only verified incomplete posting.
Report unmanaged benchmark and managed simulation with matching units and assumptions.
Reconcile to external finance systems only under an explicit authorized process.
